note: Per step: the known errors, what to try in order, and when to ask Ben. glimtool.ps1 turns an error id into the `next` list (verbs and hints; a hint starting with ask-ben: means stop and ask). Ask Ben ONLY for: no signed-in session, a login we do not have, a purchase, a Windows UAC prompt.

errors.text: ssh: connect to host 10.0.0.188 port 22: Connection timed out / refused

fixes.do: retry over Tailscale: ssh benspc (the LAN address 10.0.0.188 may be wrong)
wait 60 s and retry both routes, up to 3 times
BensPC may be off or restarting: do something else now and try again later (do not ask Ben)

errors.text: no signed-in session

fixes.do: check signed_in again in a minute (auto sign-in can still be finishing after a restart)
wait up to 3 minutes, then ping again

errors.askBenWhy: sign in to BensPC (Minecraft needs a signed-in Windows session to use the NVIDIA GPU)

errors.text: the screen is locked, so clicks and screenshots cannot work

fixes.do: client-launch and server verbs still work while locked; only desk input needs an unlocked screen
check locked again in a minute

errors.askBenWhy: BensPC screen is locked; desk clicks cannot work until it is unlocked or auto-unlock is set up

errors.text: C:\Users\benja\glim-bedwars does not exist yet (setup.ps1 has not run)

fixes.do: run setup.ps1 on BensPC (one-time; it is idempotent and has -DryRun)

errors.text: bad argument

fixes.do: re-read the verb table in TOOLS.md and call again with valid arguments

errors.text: only N GB free on C: (floor is 15 GB)

fixes.do: check free_gb again
fetch then remove old screenshots in glim-bedwars\shots (the tool keeps only the newest 60 anyway)
stop writing: do not start a match until free space is back above 15 GB; try again later

errors.text: GPU is held by <who>

fixes.do: read the holder and last_line
wait 10 minutes and gpu-acquire again; meanwhile do something else (never take the GPU from another job)
a match without the GPU is not possible: skip playing for now

errors.text: sign up for the GPU first

fixes.do: gpu-acquire --who glim-bedwars --why TEXT, then client-launch again

errors.text: GPU_LOAN.txt not found

fixes.do: do not play without the sheet; tell the coordinator thread (the sheet moved)

errors.text: the server exited while starting / did not open its port within 120 s / no Java 21 found

fixes.do: check whether it is actually running
read the tail in the error text (it comes from logs\server.out); a Java error means check C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium
stop, wait 10 s, then server-start once more
if it still fails twice, stop and report it to the coordinator thread

errors.text: port 25567 is already used by a process that is not ours

fixes.do: check it is not our own server (running:true)
never kill the other process; wait 2 minutes and try again; report to the coordinator thread if it stays

errors.text: our server is not running / nothing is listening

fixes.do: start it

errors.text: map 'X' is not in map-list

fixes.do: list the maps and pick one from the list (known: duel, squad)
if the list is empty, setup.ps1 has not copied the server: report to the coordinator thread

errors.text: opponent 'scripted:L2' is not built yet (only 'none')

fixes.do: call match-start again with --opponent none

errors.text: the client did not start / the game process did not appear within 90 s

fixes.do: clear any half-started client
check free space
launch once more; read logs\client.err via fetch --path logs\client.err
if it crashes twice, stop and report it to the coordinator thread

errors.text: GlimBot is not on the server yet

fixes.do: look at names; wait 20 s for the join
launch the client if it is not running

errors.text: the GlimBridge scheduled task is not registered

fixes.do: run setup.ps1 on BensPC (it registers the task)

errors.text: the bridge did not answer within N s

fixes.do: check signed_in
try the same verb once more; a first start of the bridge can take 10 s
if signed_in is false, follow no-session

errors.text: deskhelper reported an error

fixes.do: look at the screen again
try another way (key instead of click, or open-app Minecraft first)

errors.text: a login screen or Microsoft sign-in is on the screen

fixes.do: our own client never needs a login; if one appears, close the window with client-stop and relaunch with client-launch

errors.askBenWhy: a login is needed that Glim does not have (Glim never types Ben's password)

errors.text: a screen asks to buy something

fixes.do: do not click anything; close with client-stop

errors.askBenWhy: something asks for a purchase (Glim never buys anything)

errors.text: a Windows UAC (administrator permission) prompt appeared

fixes.do: do not touch it; wait 30 s in case it was a one-off

errors.askBenWhy: a Windows UAC prompt needs a person

errors.text: no file at <path>

fixes.do: take the screenshot again (desk screenshot), then fetch the new path

errors.text: file is N bytes (cap is 8 MB)

fixes.do: take a smaller screenshot: desk screenshot name.png --max 1280
